PicoSign bundle dependencies for the picosign bundle.

class picosign.setup.dependencies.PicoSignBundleDependencies[source]¶

Bases: TypedDict

PicoSign bundle dependencies for the picosign bundle.

It defines:

attributes:
base - The base bundle with the base components for the picosign bundle.
service - The service orchestrating the picosign’s execution for the picosign bundle.
subprocessor - The adapter executing the picosign’s sub-processes for the picosign bundle.
cli - The command-line interface adapter for the picosign bundle.
